claims.text: A randomized crossover study in 19 healthy participants found greater numerical impairment on several performance and alertness measures with ethanol plus daridorexant than daridorexant alone.
claims.quote: Coadministration with ethanol produced a numerically greater impairment on saccadic peak velocity, body sway, visual analog scale (VAS) alertness, VAS alcohol intoxication, smooth pursuit, and adaptive tracking compared with daridorexant alone.

claims.text: The EMA daridorexant label reports additive effects on psychomotor performance when 50 mg daridorexant was co-administered with alcohol.
claims.quote: Co-administration of 50 mg daridorexant with alcohol led to additive effects on psychomotor performance.

headline.text: A randomized study found numerically greater impairment with ethanol plus daridorexant than daridorexant alone.

reported.text: The study reported numerically greater impairment across eye movement, balance, alertness, intoxication, and tracking measures with coadministration.
The EMA daridorexant label reports additive effects on psychomotor performance when 50 mg daridorexant was co-administered with alcohol.
